name: WIAC Cross Country Championships
headline: WIAC Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: UW-La Crosse swept the team titles. The men won their ninth straight with 27 points ahead of UW-Stevens Point (46) and UW-Whitewater (100), and Stevens Point’s Logan Murphy won the 8K in 24:07.1. The La Crosse women scored 23 to UW-Stevens Point’s 74 and UW-Eau Claire’s 88; UW-Stout’s Claudia Lasiowski won the 6K in 21:38.5.
